1btniu9:266: EnvHarness's insight is a redefinition of the problem: the traditional route obsesses over "generating more new environments" (the quantity axis), while EnvHarness pivots to "transforming the same underlying environment into infinite variants" (the plasticity axis). It treats the standard reset/step interface as a programmable seam, inserting three plugin types — Stage/Contract/Chain — into that seam, thereby reshaping "what the agent sees, what it can do, and how long it must persist" without rewriting the underlying logic or touching the verifier.
